title: Spend your money elsewhere - this table will fall apart!
text: Spend your money elsewhere - this table will fall apart!. It lasted less than 4 months.  And the funny thing is, it was hardly ever used...it fell apart when transporting it from one room to another!  The screws are way too short to be supportive, the 'wood' (particle board?) shreds and the glue is weak.  A complete waste of money.
